detailed_descriptions.en: ● Join forces with House Davion's Kestrel Lancers to experience the 4th Succession War ● Progress through a new Linear Campaign to achieve key strategic outcomes ● Fight alongside large combined forces in all out war ● Experience intense urban combat in large all city settings with massive destruction Experience the 4th Succession War Fight in battles set during the famous Inner Sphere conflict and experience first-hand the frontlines of the 4th Succession War with 14 new campaign missions New Linear Campaign Features a new linear campaign with unique mechanics, authored missions, and custom dialogue and cinematics All Out War Experience All-Out-War scenarios with large-scale expansive combat in 7 new questlines that include 10 new "battle" scenarios Large City Urban Combat Fight in new cities that are massively larger than any previously experienced, never knowing what's around the next corner New 'Mech Variants Over 20 new variants of existing 'Mechs, New Kestrel Lancers 'Mech skin, and 5 new 'Mech-specific skins New Garrisons Discover new Garrisons including Orbital Guns firing on invasion forces, and a new 'Mech Factory Garrison featuring MW5's first indoor play space New Biomes Battle in new Mega-city, Jungle, and Tourmaline Desert biomes New Procedural Content New Procedural Content including new random rewards from Assassination Missions, and surprise Artillery on Raid Missions FREE Update content ● New ability to switch player control to any AI Lance 'Mechs ● New melee combat with the ability to damage enemy 'Mechs with your 'Mechs' fists ● Other new quality of life updates including an updated HUD, and more!

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
● Join forces with House Davion's Kestrel Lancers to experience the 4th Succession War
● Progress through a new Linear Campaign to achieve key strategic outcomes
● Fight alongside large combined forces in all out war
● Experience intense urban combat in large all city settings with massive destruction

Experience the 4th Succession War
Fight in battles set during the famous Inner Sphere conflict and experience first-hand the frontlines of the 4th Succession War with 14 new campaign missions

New Linear Campaign
Features a new linear campaign with unique mechanics, authored missions, and custom dialogue and cinematics

All Out War
Experience All-Out-War scenarios with large-scale expansive combat in 7 new questlines that include 10 new "battle" scenarios

Large City Urban Combat
Fight in new cities that are massively larger than any previously experienced, never knowing what's around the next corner

New 'Mech Variants
Over 20 new variants of existing 'Mechs, New Kestrel Lancers 'Mech skin, and 5 new 'Mech-specific skins

New Garrisons
Discover new Garrisons including Orbital Guns firing on invasion forces, and a new 'Mech Factory Garrison featuring MW5's first indoor play space

New Biomes
Battle in new Mega-city, Jungle, and Tourmaline Desert biomes

New Procedural Content
New Procedural Content including new random rewards from Assassination Missions, and surprise Artillery on Raid Missions

FREE Update content
● New ability to switch player control to any AI Lance 'Mechs
● New melee combat with the ability to damage enemy 'Mechs with your 'Mechs' fists
● Other new quality of life updates including an updated HUD, and more!
